purpose: Each frozen scoring component mapped to the product surfaces that generate its evidence records (the record fields each surface emits). All paths verified to exist at the base SHA. Evidence surfaces under packages/experience/src/sim/** are READ-ONLY for W2-011 (W3-lane); the maps below cite them for analysis.

fieldsPerComponent.switchingCostFit: NONE — persona attributes (persona.switchingCost, persona.trainingAvailability); no evidence record field
fieldsPerComponent.preferenceFit: NONE directly — derived from persona.preferredWorkflow × (integrationQuality, usabilityFriction)

mapper.role: aggregates per-journey evidence records into the per-persona JourneyOutcomeForPersona consumed by computeAdoptionDecision

evidenceSurfaces.surface: per-family visible-UI drivers (buildDriverForFamily / buildAllJourneyDrivers, lines 27-186)
evidenceSurfaces.emits: outcome ('pass'|'fail'|'blocked'|'absent'|'unknown'), successfulSteps, failedOrBlockedSteps, routeOrigin, discoveryPathKind
evidenceSurfaces.notes: the generic driver always emits outcome 'pass' (line 156); family-specific depth is the lever surface

evidenceSurfaces.surface: DiscoveryRunner.runJourney + buildAbsentRecord (lines 139-207)
evidenceSurfaces.emits: outcome 'absent' with failedOrBlockedSteps[0].reason 'no driver registered — feature not discoverable via visible UI' when a family has no driver (lines 153-207); guiOnlyProof invariant

evidenceSurfaces.surface: JOURNEY_FAMILY_REGISTRY (lines 73-287): applicableRoles, surfaces, connectorDependent, approvalRequired per family
evidenceSurfaces.emits: the applicability matrix that decides which families a persona's bundle must cover

evidenceSurfaces.surface: FEATURE_MATRIX + OPTIONAL_FEATURES (lines 40, 227) — the real navigation feature rows the gui-feature-discoverability family probes
evidenceSurfaces.emits: discoverable-feature rows (visible labels/groups) backing discoveryPathKind 'primary-navigation' and the §10.19 family

evidenceSurfaces.surface: physical no-RFID supermarket journey surface (supermarket cohort only)
evidenceSurfaces.emits: physical-capture outcomes for the physical-no-rfid-supermarket family
